high_level_description: The image is a collage of four photos showcasing the transformation of a person into the character "The Nun" from the movie "The Conjuring." The top left photo shows the person with natural makeup, wearing their hair in a braid. The top right photo displays the same person with heavy makeup applied, giving them a pale, ghostly appearance with darkened eyes and a serious expression. The bottom left photo captures the person from behind, showing the full effect of the makeup as they turn to face the camera.
